findings.issue: 間 in 間に人を入れる ('put a person in between / mediate') is read あいだ, not ま. ま is limited to set expressions (間に合う, 間もなく); the mediation sense (間に入る/間に立つ) is always あいだ.
findings.current: まにひとをいれずにかいけつしよう。
findings.suggested: あいだにひとをいれずにかいけつしよう。

findings.issue: Token 間 carries reading ま; in this construction (間に人を入れる = involve a third party) the correct reading is あいだ.
Romaji propagates the wrong reading of 間 (ma instead of aida).
楽しい glossed as 'pleasant, tasty' — 'tasty' is not a sense of 楽しい in any context (confusion with おいしい); teaches a false meaning. The pt gloss 'agradável, divertida' is correct.
Two stray null-glossed tokens 時 and 半 sit at the start of the token list, before 学校; concatenated surfaces read 時半学校は三時半に終わる。, breaking alignment with jp. The real 三+時半 tokens appear correctly later.
findings.current: tokens[0]=時, tokens[1]=半 (stray, before 学校)
findings.suggested: Delete tokens[0] 時 and tokens[1] 半; tokenization should be 学校|は|三|時半|に|終わる|。

findings.issue: ぶつける rendered as 'taps' in the literal translation; 'tap' implies a light touch, while ぶつける means to bang/knock (a body part) against something. lit_pt correctly uses 'bate'.
findings.current: Mr. Billy (topic) face (object) on the window often taps.
findings.suggested: Mr. Billy (topic) face (object) on the window often bumps/knocks.

findings.issue: Accent error in pt-BR: 'explicitos' should be 'explícitos'.
